data.adjudication: DOJ inquiry closed; Senate Ethics found no evidence of legal or rules violations.
data.claim: Loeffler and her husband sold between $1.2 million and $3.1 million in stocks after a closed-door COVID briefing. DOJ ended its inquiry and the Senate Ethics Committee said it found no evidence of a violation.
clear_connection_paths: Kelly Loeffler → closed Senate briefing → managed household trades → Intercontinental Exchange executive spouse

title: Loeffler COVID-era stock trades were investigated and dismissed
